summary: Candidate addresses a distinct capability (reserving layout space for images via width/height/aspect-ratio) that is semantically different from existing skills. Existing skills focus on image delivery optimization (lazy loading, responsive resizing), dynamic OG image generation, and font/caching strategies for CLS reduction. The candidate targets layout stabilization through explicit dimension declaration—a complementary but separate micro_skill. Peer candidates (bfcache, font fallback, font preload) address different CLS reduction mechanisms and do not overlap. No existing skill covers image dimension reservation as a layout shift prevention technique.
